transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (627x645) SnowPro-style form (older layout, no branding) -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 22/01/2006 agrees with the file name. Height axis 2.38 px/cm (0 cm y463); boundaries from H-column lines/bar edges 92/80/72/57/45/38/31/11/0 (+-1 cm); the dashed '+ 1.5' row lies above the surface (8 table rows for 8 bars). Hardness: bar widths (~14/22/46/58/46/29/22/82 px on the non-linear axis) agree with the R-column icons (+, /, X, X+, X, /+, /, //-). HW/rho column: upper value HW, lower value density (recorded). The caret glyph in the two lowest rows has a short branch (DHch per the guide's key). Temperatures: circles on 23.7 px/deg C (0 C at x265; -10 at x28); a circle sits on the surface (92 cm, -7.5; printed air temp -6.2); the 10 cm circle is inside the hatched bar (+-0.2 C).
